visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black T-shirt with white text, black-rimmed glasses, and light-colored cargo pants sits cross-legged on a low wooden cabinet. He holds a colorful magazine open with both hands, his eyes looking down through his glasses, then looking up with a slight smirk. Behind him is a tall wooden bookshelf packed with various books and a window with blinds partially pulled down. (2) The camera pans to a young woman reclining on a beige sofa, dressed in a black sleeveless outfit with a red interior accent. She is holding a smartphone in both hands, looking at it, and then she looks up toward the camera with a playful, mock-annoyed facial expression while gesturing with her free hand. (3) The scene cuts back to the man on the cabinet who stands up slightly, placing his feet on a small white stool. He gestures broadly with his right hand toward the window while holding the magazine in his left. He has a cheerful, exaggeratedly enthusiastic expression, smiling widely. (4) A close-up of the view outside the window shows a large construction site with a building wrapped in blue safety mesh and grey scaffolding under a clear sky. Cars and scooters move along the street below. The man's hand enters the frame from the left, pointing at the building. (5) The camera focuses on a row of green potted plants on the wooden windowsill, including a snake plant and various succulents. The man is seen leaning against the window frame, laughing loudly with his head tilted back and his hand resting on the glass. (6) The man sits back down on the wooden counter, closing the magazine slightly. He continues to speak with an expressive face, shifting his posture and looking directly at the camera with a humorous, satirical gaze.
